instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Rank poker hands against a board of community cards and say which hand wins", and give it board (The community cards, for example ["AS","7D","9C"]); hands.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:rank-poker-hands and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give the community cards (none to five) and each player's own cards (up to two), every card as its rank then its suit: ranks 2 to 9, T, J, Q, K, A and suits S, H, D, C, for example AS or TD.
